I want you to feel fully supported throughout your therapeutic journey. As you invest in the process, it’s important to feel informed and confident about what to expect. Explore the FAQs below to learn more about the intake process, your first session, telehealth, scheduling, and other practical aspects of therapy.

What’s your intake process?

Once we confirm an appointment time, I will email you a link to set up your secure patient portal. Through the portal, you will be able to review and complete the intake paperwork. Please complete all intake forms at least 24 hours before your first appointment so I have time to review them before we meet.

Where are you located?

My practice is currently fully virtual, and all appointments are provided via telehealth. To receive therapy through my Idaho practice, you must be physically located in Idaho at the time of each session.

Telehealth can make therapy more accessible and convenient for busy professionals, parents and caregivers, people with limited mobility, and others who prefer to attend sessions from a private location that works for them. Research suggests that video-based psychotherapy can produce outcomes comparable to in-person therapy for many common mental health concerns.

You said:

what are the next steps to add this to my github

ChatGPT said:

Assuming you want GitHub Pages to host drhuangcounseling.com, do this:

  1. Go to GitHub → New repository and create one. A name like drhuangcounseling is fine. Make it Public unless your GitHub plan supports Pages for private repos.

  2. In the repository, click Add file → Upload files. Upload these files I prepared:

    Also upload your existing images folder, preserving the folder name and filenames.

  3. Click Commit changes.

  4. Go to Settings → Pages. Under Build and deployment, choose:

    • Source: Deploy from a branch

    • Branch: main

    • Folder: / (root)

    Then click Save.

  5. GitHub will initially give you a temporary github.io address. Under Settings → Pages → Custom domain, enter:

    drhuangcounseling.com

    Your CNAME file already contains this domain.

  6. Next, you need to change the DNS records where you purchased drhuangcounseling.com so the domain points to GitHub Pages. This is the one part that depends on your domain registrar.

  7. After GitHub verifies the DNS configuration, turn on Enforce HTTPS in Settings → Pages.

  8. Test all of these:

    • https://drhuangcounseling.com

    • https://drhuangcounseling.com/zh.html

    • https://drhuangcounseling.com/robots.txt

    • https://drhuangcounseling.com/sitemap.xml

  9. After the site is live, the next SEO step is Google Search Console: verify drhuangcounseling.com, submit sitemap.xml, and request indexing of the English and Chinese pages.

The next thing I need from you is where you bought the domain—for example GoDaddy, Namecheap, Squarespace Domains, Cloudflare, Porkbun, etc. Tell me the registrar and I can give you the exact DNS records and where to enter them.
